title: Freezer Hacks You Didn't Know Existed
briefSource: Notion: Carousel Scripts - Posts 9-16 + Origin Story
editorialNotes: Bold lead words carry the arrow from the script ("Wine →") as headline; body split at sentence boundaries only.

thread.element: ice cube tray filling one cube per slide

copy.headline: You can freeze all of these. Yes, seriously.
Wine →
items: Pour leftover wine into an ice cube tray.
Drop cubes into pasta sauce, risotto, or stew.
Restaurant-level flavor from last Tuesday's bottle.

copy.headline: Fresh ginger →
items: Throw the whole root in the freezer.
Grate it straight from frozen — it shreds easier frozen than fresh.

copy.headline: Egg yolks →
items: Whisk with a pinch of salt, pour into ice cube molds.
Thaw later for custards, carbonara, or enriching sauces.

copy.headline: Overripe bananas →
copy.body: Peel first, then freeze. Frozen bananas blend into smoothies better than fresh. They also replace ice cream if you blend them solo. That's it. That's the hack.
